checkRuns.command:
python3 - <<'EOF'
import re
for p in ['src/pages/books/index.astro','src/pages/books/[slug].astro','src/pages/contact.astro']:
    s=open(p).read()
    m=re.search(r'\n<script>.*?</script>\n', s, re.S)
    script=m.group(0)
    s=s.replace(script,'\n')
    body='\n'.join('  '+l if l else l for l in script.strip('\n').split('\n'))
    s=s.replace('</Layout>', '\n'+body+'\n</Layout>')
    open(p,'w').write(s)
EOF
kill %1 2>/dev/null; pkill -f 'dist/server/entry.mjs'; bun run check 2>&1 | tail -4 && bun run build 2>&1 | tail -2 && grep -o '</main>.*' dist/client/books/index.html
pgrep -af entry.mjs; bun run check 2>&1 | tail -4 && bun run build 2>&1 | tail -2 && grep -o '</main>.*' dist/client/books/index.html; tail -5 src/pages/contact.astro

bun remove happy-dom 2>&1 | tail -1; kill %1 2>/dev/null; P=$(pgrep -f 'bun dist/server/entry'); [ -n "$P" ] && kill $P; sleep 0.5; pgrep -af 'entry\.mjs' | grep -v pgrep; bun run check 2>&1 | tail -3 && bun run build 2>&1 | tail -1; git status --short; cat package.json | grep -A3 devDep
ps aux | grep '[e]ntry.mjs'; bun run check 2>&1 | tail -3 && bun run build 2>&1 | tail -1; git status --short; grep -A3 devDep package.json
